verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. Interactive git history rewriting (deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits) is a source-control capability outside this product category, so the axis does not apply. Mentions of SSH'ing in to build code, GitHub runners, or remote coding environments describe network access, not git operations.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits
